facts.statement: This medium-sized pliosaur reached an adult body length of 7 meters.
facts.quote: It was a medium-sized pliosaur, reaching an adult body length of 7 m.

facts.statement: Fossils of the front of a plesiosaur snout were discovered in 2000 on the property of Jorge Muñoz in Loma La Cabrera, near Villa de Leyva, Boyacá, Colombia.
facts.quote: Fossils from the front of a snout of a plesiosaur were discovered in 2000 on the property of Jorge Muñoz, in Loma La Cabrera, near Villa de Leyva in Boyacá, Colombia

facts.statement: Excavation of the nearly complete skeleton took place between 2004 and 2005.
facts.quote: Then was made the excavation of the nearly complete skeleton between 2004 and 2005

facts.statement: German paleontologist Oliver Hampe initially described the specimen in 2005, classifying it as an indeterminate species of Brachauchenius.
facts.quote: German paleontologist Oliver Hampe made an initial description of the specimen in 2005, classifying it as Brachauchenius sp.

facts.statement: In 2016, a team including María Páramo and Marcela Gómez-Pérez described the holotype VL17052004-1 as a new genus and species, Stenorhynchosaurus munozi.
facts.quote: In 2016, María Páramo, Marcela Gómez-Pérez, Fernando Etayo and Leslie Noé made a more complete description and they designated to VL17052004-1 as holotype of a new genus and species, Stenorhynchosaurus munozi.

facts.statement: The genus name is derived from the Greek words stenos (narrow), rhyncho (snout), and saurus (lizard).
facts.quote: El nombre del género deriva de las palabras griegas stenos, "estrecho"; rhyncho, "hocico" y saurus, "lagarto"

facts.statement: The specific name munozi honors Jorge Muñoz for discovering and reporting the fossil.
facts.quote: munozi es en reconocimiento de Jorge Muñoz por descubrir y reportar el fósil.

facts.statement: The fossils date from the Late Barremian age of the Cretaceous and were found in marine sediments.
facts.quote: on grounds of marine origin dating from the Late Barremian age of the Cretaceous

facts.statement: The remains were found articulated mostly in the Arcillolitas Abigarradas Member of the Paja Formation, in kaolinitic argillite corresponding to an intertidal marine environment.
facts.quote: Los restos fueron hallados articulados en su mayor parte en el Segmento C del miembro Arcillolitas Abigarradas de la Formación Paja, en una arcillolita caolínitica que corresponde a un ambiente marino intermareal

facts.statement: The preserved skull measures 113 centimeters in length, though part of the posterior cranial vault is missing.
facts.quote: El cráneo mide 113 centímetros de longitud preservada, faltándole parte de la bóveda craneana posterior.

facts.statement: The face is elongated and wide, giving it a triangular shape from above, with a maximum width of 58 cm at the base of the squamosal bones.
facts.quote: Su rostro es alargado y ancho, dándole una forma triangular visto desde arriba (la anchura máxima en la base de los huesos cuadrados es 58 cm).

facts.statement: Unlike other pliosaurs, the halves of the jaw were not fused in a symphysis but had a dorsal separation of 10 millimeters.
facts.quote: Las mitades de la mandíbula no están fusionadas en una sínfisis como en otros pliosaurios, sino que tienen una separación de 10 milímetros dorsalmente.

facts.statement: It possessed 3 tooth sockets in the premaxilla and 29 in the maxilla; the teeth measured 20 to 45 mm in length and were generally similar in size and shape, making it homodont.
facts.quote: Poseía 3 alvéolos para los dientes en el premaxilar, y 29 en el maxilar; estos dientes miden de 20 a 45 mm de longitud, pero en general son de tamaño y forma similares, por lo que puede decirse que era homodonto.

facts.statement: There is no evidence that the animal was consumed by predators or scavengers after death.
facts.quote: no hay evidencia de que haya sido consumido por depredadores o carroñeros tras la muerte del animal.

facts.statement: Stenorhynchosaurus is classified within the subfamily Brachaucheninae.

rejected.statement: Stenorhynchosaurus is an extinct genus of pliosaurid plesiosaurs that lived in South America during the Early Cretaceous.
rejected.quote: Stenorhynchosaurus is an extinct genus of pliosaurid plesiosaurs which lived in the Early Cretaceous of South America.

rejected.statement: It is noted as the first reappearance of non-rhomaleosaurid pliosaurs after a hiatus between the Berriasian and Hauterivian periods.
rejected.quote: it constitutes the first reappearance of non-rhomaleosaurid pliosaurs after a hiatus between the Berriasian and Hauterivian.
